import nki, nki.language as nl, nki.isa as nisa

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out = nl.ndarray((C, H//p, W//p), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    in_tile = nl.ndarray(x.shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=in_tile, src=x)
    pool_view = in_tile.ap([[H*W, C], [p*W, H//p], [p, W//p], [W, p], [1, p]])
    sums = nl.sum(pool_view, axis=[3, 4])
    scaled = nl.ndarray(sums.shape, dtype=sums.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=scaled, data=sums, op0=nl.multiply, operand0=1.0/(p*p))
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=scaled)
    return out
